long_biography.plain_text:
Winamac, Indiana, was the base from which Ralph Braun built a global mobility-equipment manufacturer. Disabled from childhood, he designed an electric scooter and later a wheelchair lift to overcome his own transportation barriers. That enterprise grew into the Braun Corporation and eventually adopted the BraunAbility name, forming the central industrial legacy shared by his five children.

One of those children, Brent, holds the secretary's office at the Linda Braun Foundation. His fellow officers are sister Cherie Braun-Diaz, sister Melissa Dennis and brothers Drew and Todd; their unpaid board has retained this structure for more than a decade. The charitable position is distinct from corporate management. BraunAbility passed from family ownership to Patricia Industries in 2015.
